Former acting principal on the run lands in EOW net over ₹2.66 cr embezzlement in UP schools
results.description: The accused, identified as Jeet Lal Patel, former acting principal of the ATS Surwal Shahni School in Prayagraj, was arrested by an EOW Lucknow team from the Shankargarh area of Prayagraj on Monday, according to an official statement issued by the agency on Tuesday. The case pertains to alleged financial irregularities and corruption in the four government-run residential schools between the financial year 2018-19 and 2021-22.
